names.display_en: Qin Er Shi, the Second Emperor of Qin

summary: 秦始皇之后短促在位的二世皇帝，秦政崩解的关键人物。
summary_en: The Second Emperor of Qin, whose brief reign after Qin Shi Huang made him a key figure in the collapse of Qin rule.

portrait.appearance_basis: 史书侧重其政局与性格叙事，五官无可靠描写。画像宜年轻、冠服承秦制而神气弱于始皇，以作对照。

timeline.title: 即位
timeline.summary: 始皇死后即位，朝政迅速滑向高压与权臣操盘。
timeline.summary_en: He took the throne after the First Emperor's death; government quickly slid toward harsh repression and control by powerful ministers.

timeline.title: 身死国危
timeline.summary: 在起义与内斗中结局，秦中央权威崩解。
timeline.summary_en: He met his end amid uprisings and internal strife, and Qin's central authority collapsed.

relations.note: 赵高弑二世于望夷宫，立子婴，去帝号称秦王
relations.note_en: Zhao Gao assassinates the Second Emperor at Wangyi Palace and installs Ziying, who drops the imperial title and is styled King of Qin

routes.event: 在位期间主要活动于咸阳政治中心
routes.event_en: Reign centered on the Xianyang court

meta.inclusion_reason: 秦朝第二位皇帝，正史记载。

bio_md:
# 秦二世 · 主要事迹

胡亥在[[qin-shi-huang|秦始皇]]猝死后即位，在位短暂。史书呈现的主线是：深宫决策被权臣裹挟、刑法更苛、与关东烽火形成恶性循环。对图鉴而言，二世页的价值在于：

1. 展示「短祚皇帝」的信息密度如何组织；  
2. 与始皇页的继承关系对读；  
3. 作为秦末到[[han-gao-zu|汉高祖]]起兵叙事的跳板。

正文与年表仍以《史记》等通行叙事为骨架，细节争议处保持克制，待后续版本加「史说」旁注。
